title: PhosphoLIMBO: An Easy and Efficient Protocol to Separate and Analyze Phospholipids by HPTLC From Plant Material
author: Louise Fougère
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: Murashige and Skoog powder (Duchefa Biochemie, catalog number: M0222.
Cocktail protease inhibitor (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number: P9599-5ML)
HPTLC Silica gel 60 F254 20 × 10 cm (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number: 1.05642.
Potassium phosphate monobasique (KH 2 PO 4 ) (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number: P5655-500G)

steps.title: Stratify Arabidopsis seeds
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL sterile water to ~200 µL (120–160 mg dry) Col‑0 seeds in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and incubate at 4 °C for 3 days.

steps.title: Sterilize seeds with bleach
steps.instruction: Treat the stratified seeds with bleach solution for 25 min, then wash three times with sterile MilliQ water (3 min each wash).

steps.title: Prepare ½ MS liquid medium
steps.instruction: Fill a culture flask with 250 mL half‑strength Murashige and Skoog (½ MS) liquid medium, autoclave at 110 °C for 30 min, then let cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Inoculate seeds in sterile medium
steps.instruction: Transfer the sterilized seeds into the cooled sterile flask under aseptic conditions.

steps.title: Grow seedlings on shaker
steps.instruction: Place the flask on a table shaker at 110 rpm, under 16 h light/8 h dark at 22 °C for 7 days.

steps.title: Pre‑chill mortar, pestle, tubes
steps.instruction: Cool the mortar, pestle and 50 mL Falcon tubes containing membrane extraction buffer on ice.

steps.title: Harvest seedlings and weigh
steps.instruction: Collect the seedlings, discard excess liquid, and weigh to obtain at least 10 g of humid plant material.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer the plant material to the chilled mortar, add 2–3 vol (v/w) membrane extraction buffer freshly supplemented with PMSF 1 mM, and grind with the pestle until a homogeneous green slurry is obtained.

steps.title: Filter homogenate
steps.instruction: Filter the slurry through gauze placed in a funnel onto a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge to clear debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Falcon tube at 936 rcf for 10 min at 4 °C; transfer the supernatant to a new Falcon tube. Repeat the centrifugation two more times, discarding each pellet.

steps.title: Layer homogenate over sucrose cushion
steps.instruction: In a 12 mL ultracentrifuge tube add 2 mL 38 % sucrose solution, then carefully overlay 9–10 mL of the plant homogenate without disturbing the interface.

steps.title: First ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the rotor and spin at 122,253 × g for 2 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect membrane interface
steps.instruction: Using a glass Pasteur pipette, collect the yellow membrane phase at the sucrose‑supernatant interface into a 15 mL Falcon tube. If the collected volume exceeds 9 mL, split it into two 50 mL Falcon tubes.

steps.title: Dilute membrane fraction
steps.instruction: Add HEPES 50 mM buffer to the tube to bring the total volume to 12 mL and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Transfer for second spin
steps.instruction: Move the diluted suspension into fresh 12 mL ultracentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Second ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the rotor and spin again at 122,253 × g for 2 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend microsomal pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 0.2–1 mL membrane resuspension buffer (volume depends on pellet size). Pool pellets if more than one is obtained.

steps.title: Quantify protein (optional)
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration with a BCA assay; proceed only if the microsomal fraction contains ≥2 mg/mL protein.

steps.title: Add phospholipid kill mix
steps.instruction: Add 725 µL phospholipid extraction “Kill” mix to the microsomal pellet (see recipe) and continue with the extraction steps.

steps.title: Add kill mix and water
steps.instruction: In a 2 mL Eppendorf tube combine the microsomal fraction with 725 µL kill mix and 150 µL sterile MilliQ water.

steps.title: Add chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL chloroform to the tube.

steps.title: Add 2 M HCl
steps.instruction: Add 170 µL 2 M HCl.

steps.title: Vigorously mix
steps.instruction: Shake the tube vigorously by hand, then vortex for 15 s.

steps.title: Centrifuge for phase separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,500 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect lower organic phase
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the upper aqueous phase and transfer the lower chloroform phase to a new 2 mL Eppendorf tube, minimizing cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Add wash mix upper phase
steps.instruction: Pipette 710 µL of the upper phase from the phospholipid wash mix into the tube containing the lower phase.

steps.title: Mix with wash phase
steps.instruction: Shake vigorously and vortex for several seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,500 × g for 3 min.

steps.title: Collect lower phase after wash
steps.instruction: Remove the upper phase and transfer the lower phase to a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Repeat wash twice
steps.instruction: Perform the “add wash mix upper phase → mix → centrifuge → collect lower phase” sequence two additional times, discarding any water droplets that remain in the upper phase after each cycle.

steps.title: Store lipid extract
steps.instruction: Store the final lipid extract at –20 °C in a 2 mL HPLC vial.

steps.title: Prepare PhosphoLIMBO solvent
steps.instruction: In a 25 mL glass container add 5 mL chloroform, 1.7 mL methanol, 4.2 mL 2‑propanol, 1.3 mL 0.25 % KCl solution, 4 mL methyl acetate, and 0.5 mL triethylamine; mix by agitation.

steps.title: Methanol wash chamber
steps.instruction: Rinse the CAMAG twin‑trough developing chamber with methanol.

steps.title: Pre‑wash with migration solvent
steps.instruction: Add approximately 2–3 mL of the freshly prepared PhosphoLIMBO solvent to the chamber, then close it.

steps.title: Fill chamber gutters
steps.instruction: Distribute the entire volume of migration solvent equally between the two gutters of the TLC developing chamber.

steps.title: Saturate chamber
steps.instruction: Allow the chamber to stand for 25–30 min to become saturated; optionally place a heavy glass bottle inside to limit evaporation.

steps.title: Activate Linomat system
steps.instruction: Turn on the CAMAG Linomat system to prepare for plate loading.

steps.title: Prepare syringe wash
steps.instruction: Make a washing solution of chloroform/methanol 2:1 (v/v).

steps.title: Wash syringe
steps.instruction: Flush the loading syringe three times with the washing solution.

steps.title: Configure loading plan
steps.instruction: Using VisionCATs software set plate format 20 cm × 10 cm, track width 200 mm, height 100 mm, deposit height 8.0 mm, first track ≥30.0 mm; avoid loading too close to plate edges.

steps.title: Load lipid samples
steps.instruction: Place the HPTLC silica gel 60 F254 plate (20 × 10 cm) on the Linomat stage and load each sample at the programmed volume. After each sample, wash the syringe with 100 µL of washing solution three times.

steps.title: Dry loaded plate
steps.instruction: Let the loaded plate stand vertically for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Insert plate into chamber
steps.instruction: Vertically place the plate in one hinge of the twin‑trough chamber, close the chamber quickly so the plate is slightly immersed in the solvent and close to the inner wall.

steps.title: Develop plate
steps.instruction: Allow the solvent front to migrate until it is 2–3 mm from the top edge of the 10‑cm plate (≈50–55 min); do not disturb the chamber during migration.

steps.title: Remove and dry plate
steps.instruction: Take the plate out of the chamber and dry it vertically under a fume hood.

steps.title: Prepare primulin solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the primulin solution into a glass container.

steps.title: Stain plate with primulin
steps.instruction: Submerge the dried plate briefly in the primulin solution ensuring even coverage, then immediately remove it.

steps.title: Dry stained plate
steps.instruction: Dry the plate vertically in the dark for 10 min.

steps.title: Image plate under UV
steps.instruction: Visualize the plate using a 302 nm UV source on a ChemiDoc system and capture the image with Image Lab software.

description: Validation of protocol The PhosphoLIMBO protocol was used in previously published studies [3,19]. The figures of this article further validate the protocol by quantifying the Rf value, confirming the separation of all phospholipid classes by statistical tests, and testing its efficiency in biological samples.
